claim_being_audited: The model can be certified for launch based on aggregate readiness and rehearsal evidence, with compliance preserved by disclosing the unresolved disability-accommodations limitation in the model card.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows either no material weakness remains or the required disclosure/risk acceptance predicate has been satisfied.
Use suspicious when the packet points toward a supportable path but a required policy link remains unresolved.
Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch readiness, but they do not remove a specific disclosure obligation for a known material limitation.
Draft runbooks and future monitoring can support risk management, but by policy they do not substitute for current disclosure or approved mitigation.
evidence_requests: Final model card or equivalent launch artifact showing explicit disclosure of the disability accommodations intake limitation.
Approved risk-acceptance record, if the limitation will not be resolved before launch.
Approved mitigation artifact with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion if certification is being justified through mitigation rather than disclosure alone.
Decision record showing certification was conditioned on the disclosure being completed before launch.
specific_concerns: Admissible evidence shows a current unresolved weakness in a named launch use case: the disability accommodations intake slice remains below target.
The proposed mitigation is still only a draft and lacks required fields such as accountable owner and alert threshold.
The current model-card draft says there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with reviewer concern and the unresolved slice issue.
Policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
No admissible evidence shows that the required disclosure has been made or that an approved risk acceptance exists.
The recommended action overreaches if interpreted as immediate unconditional certification.
unsupported_claims: That certification is currently compliant without first showing the required disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
That draft monitoring and rollback planning are sufficient to satisfy the policy predicate for certification without material caveats.
That the current model-card materials already accurately disclose the unresolved limitation.
